data.question: How many children did Swiss painter Johann Caspar Füssli have with his wife, Elisabeth?

passages.text: When Johann Caspar Füssli was born on 3 January 1706, in Zürich, Switzerland, his father, Hans Rudolf Füssli, was 26 and his mother, Elisabetha Scherrer, was 26. He married Anna Elisabeth Waser on 22 January 1736, in Zürich, Switzerland. They were the parents of at least 7 sons and 11 daughters. He died on 6 May 1782, in his hometown, at the age of 76.
